pr_body:
The broken test randomized over frozen and cold allocation on a specific node.
This randomly ran into the combination of trying to allocate a frozen shard
to a node that had no shared cache available which broke tests expectations.

-> fix by just having a shared cache available on each node to keep tests using specific data nodes
to specific nodes simple.

closes #68591
pr_title: Fix Searchable Snapshot Cache Test Settings Conflict
